program.name: Financial / Funding / Convention District

buildings.name: The Aequitas Exchange
buildings.purpose: Research securities, institutional bonds, resource contracts, and long-term technology investment
buildings.exteriorSignature: three balancing ledger slabs, elliptical contour plaza, titanium cantilever, transparent partnership pylons, and open artificial-horizon crown

buildings.name: Meridian Research Bank
buildings.purpose: Project escrow, infrastructure finance, research payroll, and long-duration capital management
buildings.exteriorSignature: grooved basalt lower stratum, floating bronze-glass upper volume, golden shadow incision, reflecting pool, steel world sphere, and photovoltaic fin canopy

buildings.name: Venture Prism
buildings.purpose: Venture capital, startup financing, prototype showcases, and researcher-commercial meetings
buildings.exteriorSignature: leaning crystalline facets, black investment-graph seams, empty silhouette fins, transparent showcase podium, fractured canopy, and retractable prototype plinths

buildings.name: Helix Grant House
buildings.purpose: Public grants, fellowships, emergency research finance, and independent investigator support
buildings.exteriorSignature: two pale ceramic spiral wings, through-garden, glowing molecular bridges, branching canopy columns, memorial pools, and planted alpine roof ribbons

buildings.name: The Patent Lantern
buildings.purpose: Patent registration, licensing, technology transfer, open-license coordination, and partnership brokerage
buildings.exteriorSignature: luminous milky inner cylinder, perforated technical-notation shell, peeled page entrances, mirrored aperture vanes, water ramp, and ownership-network plaza

buildings.name: Black Swan Risk Tower
buildings.purpose: Insurance and reinsurance for hazardous research and catastrophic project failure
buildings.exteriorSignature: absorptive black leaning blade, shock-wave buttresses, fragmented red probability curves, sunken storm plaza, folded-wing canopy, swan abstraction, and visible weather crown

buildings.name: The Impact Ledger
buildings.purpose: Climate finance, biodiversity investment, restoration bonds, and social-impact accounting
buildings.exteriorSignature: green and silver setback towers, six micro-landscape terraces, five copper-mesh garden bridges, expressed irrigation, duration displays, and vertical material ledger

buildings.name: Patron Constellation Hall
buildings.purpose: Philanthropic foundations, scientific patronage, prizes, endowments, and fundraising events
buildings.exteriorSignature: blue-black titanium dome, curved luminous fissures, satellite volumes and passages, fibre-optic program sky, alabaster crescents, circular pool, and anonymous bronze patron strips

buildings.name: Sovereign Science Fund Forum
buildings.purpose: Multinational funding agreements, treaty funds, and scientific-development initiatives
buildings.exteriorSignature: equal multicolour stone fins around glazed drum, kinetic delegation rings, inward roof aperture, suspended artificial moon, ceremonial avenue, and permanent public debate tables

buildings.name: The Clearing Vault
buildings.purpose: Transaction clearing, distributed records, identity verification, archives, and high-value data custody
buildings.exteriorSignature: deep metallic cell matrix, electrochromic calculation waves, illuminated cut corners, pale dry moat, four narrow bridges, disguised scanners, and shielded synchronization dish

buildings.name: Astra Confluence Convention Centre
buildings.purpose: Flagship congresses, funding summits, product presentations, public exhibitions, and international conventions
buildings.exteriorSignature: open crescent, gravitational-wave photovoltaic roof, permeable fin facade, three immense branching portals, configurable park terraces, and northern luminous roof arc

buildings.name: The Modular Congress Yards
buildings.purpose: Trade fairs, technology expos, laboratory-equipment exhibitions, and industrial demonstrations
buildings.exteriorSignature: six halls with sawtooth, barrel, folded, dome, terrace, and technical roofs; exposed trusses and rails; numbered canopy; visible ordered freight court; and rain gardens

buildings.name: The Delegate Spire
buildings.purpose: Visiting delegation offices, conference chairs, negotiators, and intergovernmental missions
buildings.exteriorSignature: stacked reversing floor rotations, pale treaty-page fins, restrained identity bands, displaced illuminated colonnade, secure landscape terraces, hovering eastern room, and Alpine-aligned beacon

buildings.name: The Arbitration Basilica
buildings.purpose: Contract arbitration, IP disputes, funding mediation, ethics hearings, and international scientific-commercial law
buildings.exteriorSignature: long pale civic mass, dark visible-repair seams, empty black threshold frame, opposing roof fins and unresolved light gap, formal side gardens, and concentric public rulings forum

buildings.name: Chronos Futures Observatory
buildings.purpose: Long-range forecasting, roadmaps, prediction markets, scenario modelling, and convention closing sessions
buildings.exteriorSignature: bronze-lined mirrored tower, vast shadow disc, branching underside timelines, long-duration display ring, twelve-domain radial plaza, framed real-sky void, and rotating sensor rings

circulation.capitalCrescent: curved promenade toward Luxury and Entertainment
circulation.confluenceGrounds: wide convention promenade toward Entry and Logistics

publicRealm.palette: pale engineered stone, black basalt, smoked glass, titanium, bronze, ceramic, translucent composites, and controlled media

program.lightingProtocol: gold and white civic funding light; cold silver, violet, and blue private-capital light; restrained media; convention roof arcs; reflected water; dark planted terraces
program.architecturalIntent: finance as the island circulation system rather than its ruling ideology, with visible tension among public science, private capital, political influence, and uncertain futures
